_comment: Plates made for an article, by slug: each closes the chapter named (`chapter` is its heading; the opening chapter's is the article's display title) with the HTML fragment plates/<html>. Pictures in a fragment are src="plate:<file in plates/>". The Sea Road's map is drawn by plates/sea-road-map.mjs and rendered by plates/render.sh.

sea-road-china-gulf.chapter: The Sea Road from China to the Gulf
